t:
Requires a Milwaukee 12 V RedLithium Battery (Sold separately).

High performance motor delivers up to 500rpm and cuts 12mm copper pipe in seconds. RedLink overload protection and constant speed electronics provide durability and performance. Auto-locking cut mechanism cuts installed copper tubing with as little as 37mm clearance. All-metal sealed front end with rust and corrosion-resistant cut head. On-board fuel gauge and LED light for added user convenience and illumination in low lit working conditions. Supplied with M12 RedLithium-Ion battery and blow-moulded case.
